latch_width = 12.0

latch_thickness = 3.0
latch_offset_from_bottom = 5.0

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face, bottom_face])

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, rib_position))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (outer_radius + rib_height, rib_position))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (outer_radius + rib_height, rib_position + rib_width))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (outer_radius, rib_position + rib_width))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (outer_radius, body_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, body_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))

    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, body_length - counterbore_depth / 2) * Cylinder(counterbore_diameter / 2, counterbore_depth)

solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, body_length - pocket_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_length, pocket_depth)
